strongest_angle: The Moore-Miller administration's 2027 Tenants' Bill of Rights, effective October 1, 2026, mandates critical updates to lease disclosures and tenant protections across Maryland.

key_facts.fact: The Maryland Department of Housing and Community Development published the 2027 Tenants' Bill of Rights on October 1, 2026, to reflect new state housing legislation.
key_facts.source_name: Maryland Department of Housing and Community Development

key_facts.fact: Maryland law requires landlords to attach the most current version of the Tenants' Bill of Rights to every lease agreement without any modifications.
key_facts.source_name: Maryland Department of Housing and Community Development

key_facts.fact: The 2027 Tenant’s Bill of Rights, which took effect on October 1, 2026, provides both tenants and landlords with the most current information regarding state housing protections.
